name: waza
description: 中文优先的工程技能合集，适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、OpenCode 和 Pi：think、how、design、check、hunt、write、learn、read、health、handoff。核心不超过十个，覆盖方案、走读、审查、调试、设计、阅读、写作、研究和交接。

plugins.name: waza
plugins.description: 安装完整 Waza 工具集，在 waza namespace 下注册十个核心技能：/waza:think、/waza:how、/waza:design、/waza:check、/waza:hunt、/waza:write、/waza:learn、/waza:read、/waza:health 和 /waza:handoff。Claude Code v2.1.143 或更新版本可用 /plugin install waza-<name>@waza 单独安装一个技能。

plugins.name: waza-check
plugins.description: 审查代码 diff、PR、issue 队列、发布准备、commit、push、publish 和项目审计，并用规范轴、规格轴和影响面核对。Use when users ask review/看看代码/合并前/看看issue/PR/release/push/blast radius or to implement an approved plan, with safety gates for dirty and untracked worktrees. Not for exploring ideas, debugging root causes, or prose review.

plugins.name: waza-design
plugins.description: 做有方向感、可交付的 UI：页面、组件、视觉界面、字体排印和基于截图的 polish。Use when users ask 设计/做页面/做组件/UI/前端/截图 or say a screen is ugly, unclear, inconsistent, or visually wrong. Not for backend logic or data pipelines.

plugins.name: waza-handoff
plugins.description: 把当前会话压缩成一份交接文档，或按下一会话用途从现有材料重建上下文。Use when users ask handoff/交接/写交接文档/dump context/summarize session/recall. Not for regular writing, editing, or de-AI tasks.

plugins.name: waza-health
plugins.description: 做预算友好的 agent-assisted engineering health 审计，覆盖指令/配置漂移、hooks/MCP、验证面、AI 可维护性和会话复盘。Use when users ask 检查claude/检查codex/检查pi/配置检查/健康度/retro or report agents ignoring instructions, missing validation, or code becoming hard to maintain. Not for debugging code or reviewing PRs.

plugins.name: waza-how
plugins.description: 解释一个子系统现在怎么工作，或判断这段代码应该放在哪一层。Use when users ask 怎么工作的/走读/where should this live/how does this work/which layer owns this before changing it. Not for why it was built that way, value judgments, or root-cause debugging.

plugins.name: waza-hunt
plugins.description: 在修复前先找到错误、崩溃、回归、失败测试和异常行为的根因。硬问题按反馈环、缩小、假设、观测、修复走。Use when users ask 排查/报错/崩溃/不工作/回归/判断为什么报错/diagnose, or say something used to work and now fails. Not for code review or new features.

plugins.name: waza-learn
plugins.description: 用六阶段研究流程，把陌生领域、来源集合或已收集材料整理成可发布输出。Use when users ask 学习一下/深入研究/研究一下/整理成文章/deep dive/compile sources or need one coherent reference from many inputs. Not for quick lookups or single-file reads.

plugins.name: waza-read
plugins.description: 读取 URL 和 PDF，按来源选择抓取方法；普通阅读给简洁摘要，需要转换、保存、引用、cite 或交给下游工作时输出干净 Markdown. Use when users ask 看这个链接/读一下/read this/check this URL. Not for local text files already in the repo.

plugins.name: waza-think
plugins.description: 把粗略想法变成可批准、决策完整的实施计划，必要时压测决策树、画模块草图或做一次性原型。Use when users ask 出方案/给方案/深入分析/怎么设计/有没有必要/值不值得/plan this/how should I/should we keep this/grill me/architect this for features, architecture, or value judgments. Not for bug fixes, root-cause debugging, or small edits.

plugins.name: waza-write
plugins.description: 改写和润色中英文自然语言，去掉 AI 味，审阅产品本地化文案，并保留原意。Use when users ask 帮我写/改稿/润色/去AI味/写一段/审稿/本地化文案/tweet/unslop/rewrite/proofread. Not for code comments, commit messages, or inline docs.
